1.body:
Hello,

I saw the UX/UI Designer opening at Tarmeez Capital and wanted to apply, especially given your focus on mentorship and collaborative product development.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and fed those findings back into user flows and interface usability, while bringing a Computer Science background from my B.Tech to developer handoffs.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists, which you can review in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we take a brief look at that case study together this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
